title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Overdue, Lost Equipment and Dispute Window Figures
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental class figures for unreturned equipment and for disputing return charges.

| Equipment class | Hours after the due-back time and grace before equipment is overdue | Days in overdue status before equipment is treated as lost | Lost equipment administrative fee, USD | Damage dispute window, calendar days after return |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 24 | 7 | 25.00 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 24 | 7 | 25.00 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 24 | 7 | 50.00 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 24 | 7 | 75.00 | 14 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 12 | 5 | 150.00 | 14 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 12 | 5 | 250.00 | 14 |

## Terms of the table

- **Overdue threshold**: the hours, after the due-back time plus the class's return grace, after which equipment not yet returned is marked overdue.
- **Conversion threshold**: the calendar days in overdue status after which unreturned equipment is treated as lost and converted.
- **Lost equipment administrative fee**: the fee added to the replacement value of converted or lost equipment.
- **Damage dispute window**: the calendar days after return within which the renter may dispute a damage, cleaning, fuel or missing accessory charge.

## Points of comparison

- Aerial and earthmoving equipment becomes overdue sooner (12 hours) and converts sooner (5 days) than the other classes (24 hours and 7 days).
- The dispute window is 7 days for the first three classes and 14 days for Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry, Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting and Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment.
